headline: Army and Navy maintain the highest levels of confidence among U.S. companies in Mexico: AmCham
summary: AmCham Mexico's 2026 security survey found 17% of US companies have reduced investment in Mexico because of insecurity. Firms expect security to improve within the next five years.
why: Foreign direct investment in Mexico depends on business confidence, and security concerns can influence where multinationals build plants and hire.
original_headline: Ejército y Marina mantienen los niveles más altos de confianza de empresas de EU en México: AmCham
